tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_6.csv')
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
stats = g.agg(['mean','median','std','max','count'])
# z-score within group using median/MAD for robustness
df['med'] = g.transform('median')
def mad(s): return (s - s.median()).abs().median()
df['mad'] = g.transform(mad)
df['z'] = 0.6745*(df['BilledCost']-df['med'])/df['mad'].replace(0,np.nan)
top = df.sort_values('z', ascending=False).head(15)
print(top[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','med','z']])
